lane: فغفور فغفورى فَغْفُورِىٌّ [China-ware, or porcelain,] the [sort of] خَزَف that is brought from China; so called from فَغْفُور, [the title of] the king of China: vulgarly فَرْفُورِى. (TA in art. فر.)
